historical_predecessor: Stage81A3 PCA/REP/subspace qualification; TD13-15 subspace/operator attacks; TD16 common-support loading and OPC dependency/module attacks
what_is_materially_new: Tests source-specific per-gene-affine-invariant relational geometry among independently shared native biological classes, rather than alignment of genes, loadings, axes, or dependency edges.
historical_failure_being_attacked: Same-gene target objects fail cross-source replication; determine whether a coarser relational biological object survives actual source/cohort differences.
class_eligibility_rule: native_class shared HVS/SEA_AD in frozen Sample B with >=30 cells and >=20 donors in each source; yielded 19 classes
gene_panels: 4 disjoint deterministic hash panels of 2,048 common-scalar addresses; joint-variable gene mask per panel across both sources
transformation: for each source and panel, donor-balanced class centroids; gene-by-gene z-standardization across classes; normalized Euclidean class-distance matrix
null: class-identity permutation in SEA_AD; 1000 permutations for 19-class geometry, 3000 for 8-class subgeometries
critical_caveat: native_class annotations are transcriptomic labels and may be used as a validation anchor/positive control, not as the definition of the production target
